description: This PHP source file contains functions related to building and rendering execution trees of test plans in the TestLink project. It includes functions for initializing configuration, filtering test cases, preparing tree nodes, and rendering the execution tree structure for test management and execution purposes.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Manager class for handling test plan related operations, including tree management.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Manager class for handling test project related operations.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: Manager class for handling custom field operations.

methods.name: execTree
methods.description: Builds the execution tree for test cases within a given context, returning a structured object for rendering.

methods.name: testPlanTree
methods.description: Generates a test plan tree structure for test management, reflecting test cases, suites, and statuses.

methods.name: initExecTree
methods.description: Initializes filter and options arrays for building the execution tree based on user-defined filters and settings.

methods.name: prepareExecTreeNode
methods.description: Prepares individual nodes in the execution tree, aggregating test case statuses and filtering nodes.

methods.name: applyStatusFilters
methods.description: Filters test cases in the tree based on execution status and test plan filters.

methods.name: helperInitCounters
methods.description: Initializes counters for test case statuses.

methods.name: cfForDesign
methods.description: Filters and retrieves custom fields relevant for test design from a provided set.
